reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

I checked transfer TRF-INV-88 for ₦250,000 to your Access Bank account (0234567891). While our system shows it as "failed", I queried your bank directly for the final status, and they confirmed the transfer was actually successful — the ₦250,000 was credited to your account on 21 November 2026 at 14:02.

Details:
- Amount: ₦250,000
- Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088
- Credited: 21 Nov 2026, 14:02

Because the money has already reached your account, we won't be resending the transfer — doing so would result in a double payment of ₦500,000.

Please check your account statement for 21 November, or ask Access Bank to trace that session ID if it isn't showing. If you've checked and still can't locate the credit, let me know and we'll escalate to a person on our team to sort it out with the bank.

Apologies for the confusion our system status caused.
